name: Wix Stores
description: Connect your Wix Stores site so the agent can look up a customer's orders, track shipments, cancel or re-route undispatched orders, issue refunds, and answer product questions.

wix_find_customer.label: Find Customer
wix_find_customer.description: Find a customer by email, with their most recent orders.

wix_list_customer_orders.label: List Customer Orders
wix_list_customer_orders.description: List a customer's orders by email, most recent first.

wix_get_order.label: Get Order
wix_get_order.description: Get an order by id or number: items, totals, address, payments, tracking and support eligibility.

wix_get_order_tracking.label: Get Order Tracking
wix_get_order_tracking.description: Get an order's fulfilment status and shipment tracking.

wix_cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
wix_cancel_order.description: Cancel an order that has not been dispatched, optionally restocking and emailing the buyer.

wix_create_refund.label: Create Refund
wix_create_refund.description: Refund an order in full or in part, capped at the remaining refundable balance.

wix_update_order_shipping_address.label: Update Order Shipping Address
wix_update_order_shipping_address.description: Change where an undispatched order will ship. Refuses once fulfilment has started.

wix_search_products.label: Search Products
wix_search_products.description: Search the catalog by name or description.

wix_get_product.label: Get Product
wix_get_product.description: Get a product with its variants, pricing and stock status.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Wix API key from Settings → API Keys, scoped to Orders (read & manage), Order Billing (refunds), Order Fulfillments (read) and Catalog (read). Treated as a secret.

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The Wix site ID this key is scoped to (from your dashboard URL or the Query Sites API).
